subject: Double charge on invoice INV-2026-04231 - need refund
body:
Hello,

your system charged my card twice for the April Pro subscription. Stripe shows two separate transactions on April 30, both for 49 EUR, transaction IDs ending in -a8f2 and -b3c1.

I have already opened a dispute with my bank but would prefer to handle this directly with you. Please refund the duplicate charge (49 EUR) within 5 business days, otherwise my finance team will require us to switch providers.

Attached is the Stripe statement. Our customer ID is cus_PqR2xLn88kF and the invoice in question is INV-2026-04231.

We are on the Pro plan for our 4-person modeling team and otherwise satisfied with the product, so I would rather resolve this than churn.

Thanks,
Markus Kraus
Finance, Kraus Engineering GmbH
